dialogues.speaker: "Small Cliff" Advertisement
dialogues.text: "The safest and simplest of extreme sports you could imagine — perfect for beginners! Head over to the small cliff to experience the joys of climbing for yourself!"

dialogues.speaker: Message
dialogues.text: "How can something that safe even be called an extreme sport? Doesn't seem fun in the slightest. If this is what the rock climbing in Natlan's like, I might as well have just stayed at home and gone hiking on my own."

dialogues.speaker: Edited Advertisement
dialogues.text: "The most authentic and challenging of extreme sports you could imagine — perfect for those looking for a challenge! Head over to the small cliff to experience the joys of climbing for yourself!"
